name: evyent
description: Evyent - the operating system for every event. One master event, unlimited connected phases.

scripts.dev: npm run bootstrap && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @evyent/web && npm run build -w @evyent/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @evyent/api && npm run typecheck -w @evyent/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run bootstrap && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
